$comment: Advisories accepted for the runtime dependency tree, with the reason and the date of the review. Anything not listed here fails scripts/audit-gate.js. Reviewed 2026-10-27.

accepted.reason: no patched release in the 1.20.x line that express 4 depends on; the advisory is about a silently disabled size limit and this API sets an explicit 10 KB JSON limit
same package, trailing bytes after a compressed body; the service never accepts compressed request bodies (no content-encoding support is negotiated)
no patched 0.1.x release; exploitation needs attacker-controlled route patterns, and every route of this service is a static literal
max-stale cross-user disclosure, no fix released for 4.1.1; the endpoint under study only inspects the policy and never stores or replays a response
